# requires: store
#
# Two listeners on one store are independent: each has its own present, and
# taking a notice from one takes nothing from the other.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=file
watch W 300
watch V 300
next W
claim A alpha 60000
next W
next V
next V

# expect 4: changed
# expect 4: A=pending/0
# expect 6: changed
# expect 6: A=running/0
# expect 7: changed [WATCH-X2]
# expect 7: A=running/0
# expect 8: quiet [WATCH-X2]
